parsed.rationale: All four members are `type-alias-object` declarations with empty `fields_or_signature` lists, meaning they are structurally identical only because they are all zero-field type aliases — not because they encode the same domain concept. `ApplicationWillTerminateMessage` (Core package, Observation layer), `PlaybackStalledMessage` and `HLSPlaybackStalledMessage` (Playback package, two distinct player subsystems), and `RequestSentMessage` (MusicShareKit package, network layer) each represent a distinct domain event in an unrelated subsystem. The shared structure is purely coincidental: every empty-body message type will look identical to the analyzer regardless of semantic meaning. Merging or extracting them would conflate unrelated domain events and destroy the intentional naming that distinguishes them at call sites.
